translations.web: I also will laugh at your disaster. I will mock when calamity overtakes you,
translations.bsb: in turn I will mock your calamity; I will sneer when terror strikes you,
translations.kjv: I also will laugh at your calamity; I will mock when your fear cometh;
translations.asv: I also will laugh in the day of your calamity; I will mock when your fear cometh;
